description:
Round-28 perf lever L5 (docs/plan-speed-and-ir-s470.md §A.2 row 4).

=== DONE (s470bp) ===

`@h{qw(a b)} = (…)`, `@a[1..3] = (…)`, `@a[0,2] = (…)` are idiomatic Perl and
their subscripts are known while the file is COMPILED.  The general arms of
`p-setf`'s two slice cases could not know that: they built the subscript list
at RUN time — a dolist over the subscript expressions, consing a list,
nreversing it — and walked it beside the source vector, every iteration, for a
list that never changes.

THE LICENCE is `%p-const-subscript-values`, a compile-time reading of the place
form.  Three shapes occur in PCL's emission for a literal slice and only three:
a self-evaluating number or string, a quoted literal, and a literal numeric
range `(p-.. A B)`.  Anything else answers NIL and takes the general path.  A
DESCENDING literal range yields the EMPTY list — perl's own answer — so the
call site reads "empty" as "no licence", not as "assign nothing".

NOT SKIPPED: the RHS is evaluated once and SNAPSHOTTED before the first store
(#818); a missing value is *p-undef* and an extra one is dropped; the value of
the assignment is still the source vector; the STORE is the same
`(setf (p-aref …))` / `(setf (p-gethash …))`.  The container expression is
re-emitted per store, exactly as the general loop re-evaluates it per
iteration.

Two helpers also REMOVE an existing duplication (rule 11): the array arm and
the hash arm each spelled the source binding and the store loop out.

NO PCL_OPT NAME (task #1181's precedent): a runtime MACRO with no emission to
switch; `pl2cl`'s output is byte-identical with and without it.  So the guard
rows are MACROEXPANSIONS with negatives beside them.

MEASURED.  Hand-replaced A/B first: `sliceasgn` **-62.7 %** against a
byte-identical control pair at +0.5 %.  SHIPPED, as a two-core runtime A/B
against a `027ba9c` runtime (tools/bench-exec.pl BENCH_RT_B, best-of-5 and
best-of-7): **sliceasgn -43.5 % / -44.3 %** (2.20x -> 1.24x/1.17x of perl).

BARS: gate 210 files / 7132+ rows (only the 13 pclxs xs rows); 21 probe shapes
vs perl 5.40.3 identical, and identical on a `027ba9c` runtime; guard
`Pl/t/perf-levers-02.t`, inverse-verified (its three mechanism rows fail with
the base runtime in place).

FOUND, NOT FIXED (pre-existing, filed #1206): a slice assignment in SCALAR
context yields the source vector where perl yields the COUNT.  The
NON-constant twin answers the same, which is how it was classified.
subject: L5/#1203 SHIPPED (s470bp): a CONSTANT-subscript slice assignment is N direct stores — sliceasgn -43.5 % shipped (-62.7 % hand-replaced), 2.20x -> 1.17x of perl
